title: Logistics Manager
description:
**About Sundays for Dogs**


Sundays for Dogs is a founder\-led, direct\-to\-consumer brand reimagining pet food so dog owners can spend more quality time with their dogs — now and later. We make human\-grade, air\-dried food that supports long, healthy lives, and we build our company around shared core values that guide how we work and how we treat each other.

  

We’re headquartered in Cleveland, Ohio, with a primarily remote team of \~50 full\-time employees across the U.S. While we work distributed day to day, we come together in person on a quarterly basis because relationships matter. Our business today is 100% DTC, with our subscription model at the core of how we serve customers — and we’re building to scale with intention. We’re just getting started...

 **About your team and position:**


The Supply Chain team is a lean, high\-ownership function responsible for Sundays' full fulfillment network \- from co\-manufacturer production through 3PL warehousing to final delivery. Historically run by a single person, we're now building out dedicated roles for the first time, and this position is part of that first wave. The Logistics Manager will own freight, fulfillment, and carrier performance end\-to\-end—from daily 3PL execution to freight budget accountability. You'll build the reporting, audit, and traceability infrastructure this function needs to scale, and become the go\-to point of contact for carriers, 3PLs, and Customer Care on all things logistics. Reports to the Supply Chain Manager. No direct reports currently, though this may evolve as the team grows. You'll collaborate closely with Customer Care, Food Safety \& Quality, and Finance on a regular basis.

**Your day\-to\-day:**

* Own day\-to\-day 3PL fulfillment performance, ensuring shipments consistently meet OTIF and SLA targets.
* Manage domestic freight and carrier relationships, including rate negotiations, to control costs and maintain service levels.
* Audit freight billing and resolve claims, recovering costs from carrier overcharges or service failures.
* Own the freight \& logistics budget, tracking spend and reporting variance to leadership monthly.
* Build and maintain real\-time logistics and carrier performance reporting as the source of truth for the business.
* Maintain full product traceability from co\-manufacturer through delivery, partnering with Food Safety \& Quality on any investigations.
* Serve as the primary point of contact between Customer Care and the 3PL network for fulfillment and delivery issues.

**What success looks like:**

* First 30 days: Complete onboarding across freight and 3PL systems, map the current carrier and 3PL network, and independently audit a sample of freight bills.
* First 3 months: Fully own freight auditing, claims resolution, and budget tracking; launch a live logistics performance dashboard; document core SOPs.
* Ongoing metrics: OTIF/SLA performance at or above target, freight spend tracked within budget with proactive variance reporting, and freight claims resolved on a consistent predictable timeline.

**We'd love to hear from you if you have:**

* You have 5\+ years of experience in logistics or transportation, ideally within CPG. Experience with cross\-border OTR freight is a plus.
* You have proven experience auditing freight invoices and recovering costs from carrier errors.
* You have direct experience negotiating rates or contract terms with carriers.
* You have the ability to build and maintain performance reporting using tools like Google Sheets, Looker, or similar platforms.
* You have a track record of independently building processes where none previously existed.
* You have strong interpersonal skills and are comfortable holding external vendors accountable.

description:
**Plant Manager**

**Job Purpose:**

Now is a great time to join Nopak, a leader in fluid power located in the Greater Milwaukee Area. As our privately held business undertakes a significant growth initiative, we are looking for a hands\-on manufacturing leader to run our shop floor as Plant Manager. This role reports to the Director of Finance \& Operations and is a key member of the manufacturing leadership team.

This is a floor job. The Plant Manager is expected to spend 90% or more of the day in the shop — at the machines, with the machinists, in front of the schedule board — not behind a desk. You will own the daily execution of Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost across machining, welding, assembly, test, and paint.

The ideal candidate came up through a CNC machine shop and never lost the instinct for it. You can read a print, look at a setup and know it is costing you twenty minutes a cycle, question a tooling choice, and tell the difference between a capacity problem and a scheduling problem. You are equally comfortable coaching a first\-year machinist and holding a twenty\-year veteran to a standard.

You will lead two direct reports: the Manufacturing Engineering Manager, who owns CNC programming, tooling, and fixture design; and the Shop Supervisor, who runs the 26\-person direct labor workforce across machining, welding, assembly, and paint. Quality is led by the Engineering Manager, and scheduling and purchasing are led by the Planning Manager, so partnership across those functions is essential.

Nopak is a high\-mix, low\-volume environment where no two weeks look alike, and the plant runs on the judgment of the person leading it. We pride ourselves on helping energetic, ambitious employees thrive in our entrepreneurial and fast\-paced culture. If you are looking for the opportunity to make a lasting impact on a growing manufacturer, we want to hear from you.

**Responsibilities:**

Floor Leadership \& Daily Execution

* Own daily execution of Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost across all manufacturing operations — machining, welding, assembly, test, and paint.
* Spend the workday on the production floor driving production; this role is not desk\-based.
* Lead structured SQDC huddles and daily KPI review cadences on the floor; escalate what needs escalating and resolve what does not.
* Own and manage manufacturing KPIs including labor productivity, on\-time delivery, scrap and rework rates, and schedule attainment; take corrective action promptly when targets are missed.
* Directly oversee the Shop Supervisor and hold them accountable for daily manpower deployment, shift execution, and direct labor performance across 26 employees.
* Work daily with the Planning Manager and scheduling staff to sequence work, resolve conflicts, and protect promised delivery dates.
* Identify capacity constraints and bottlenecks before they become late orders, and bring options rather than problems.
* Sustain accountability to plant processes, standard work, and shop floor data accuracy in the ERP system.
* Flex schedule as needed to provide off\-shift and weekend coverage during critical production periods.
* Maintain facility and grounds in a safe, organized, and productive condition.

Manufacturing Engineering \& CNC Operations

* Oversee the Manufacturing Engineering Manager and the CNC programming team; hold them accountable for program quality, tooling strategy, fixture design, and setup efficiency.
* Drive setup reduction initiatives across CNC milling and turning operations, targeting non\-value\-added time and machine utilization.
* Evaluate and improve machining practices, tooling applications, and fixturing solutions to increase throughput and reduce cost per part.
* Ensure CNC programming standards, G\-code/M\-code practices, and CAD/CAM workflows (Mastercam, SolidWorks, or equivalent) are documented and consistently applied.
* Own preventive maintenance execution and machine condition; escalate reliability issues before they cost a shipment.
* Stay current on emerging machining technology and identify opportunities to improve capability, reduce cycle time, and expand Nopak’s manufacturing capacity.

People Leadership \& Development

* Build and sustain a culture of ownership on the shop floor — hire well, set clear standards, give direct feedback, and address performance issues promptly.
* Develop and execute the machinist training and cross\-training program; build the bench Nopak needs to grow.
* Manage daily payroll data accuracy, discipline processes, performance reviews, and employee development plans for all direct and indirect reports.
* Develop and implement programs to recognize and reward high\-performance employees.
* Represent the floor in leadership discussions on capacity, staffing, and manufacturability.

Quality on the Floor

* Own execution of quality standards, inspection discipline, and work instruction compliance on the shop floor.
* Partner with the Engineering Manager and the Quality function on root cause analysis and corrective action for quality escapes, ensuring systemic fixes rather than reactive patches.
* Drive reduction in scrap, rework, and customer returns through operator training, setup verification, and in\-process checks.
* Ensure the manufacturing team is fluent in the quality standards and inspection requirements that apply to their work.

Safety \& Compliance

* Champion a culture of safety across all shifts; administer the safety program in partnership with HR and the safety committee.
* Lead 5S audit corrective actions and maintain housekeeping standards across all manufacturing areas.
* Ensure all employees operate in compliance with OSHA standards and Nopak safety protocols.
* Conduct or oversee safety training, incident investigations, and corrective action plans.

Cost \& Continuous Improvement

* Partner with the Director of Finance \& Operations on labor efficiency, job variances, material usage, and scrap; explain the drivers behind the numbers and own the corrective actions.
* Supply accurate routings, cycle times, and shop floor data to support standard costing and quoting.
* Lead continuous improvement activity on the floor — kaizen events, layout changes, and process standardization — and sustain the gains.

*An individual in this position must be able to successfully perform the essential duties and responsibilities listed above. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.*

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Minimum 2 years’ experience leading manufacturing operations with direct accountability for production, quality, and safety outcomes.
* Minimum 3 years’ experience supervising or managing others in a manufacturing environment.
* Extensive hands\-on experience in a CNC machine shop environment with deep working knowledge of CNC milling and CNC turning operations.
* Strong working knowledge of CNC programming concepts (G\-code/M\-code), tooling strategy, fixture design, and setup reduction — sufficient to evaluate, coach, and hold the manufacturing engineering team accountable.
* Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, GD\&T, and specifications.
* Demonstrated experience driving floor\-level accountability for labor productivity, on\-time delivery, and quality KPIs in a high\-mix, low\-volume manufacturing environment.
* Proven track record of implementing setup reduction, tooling improvements, and machining efficiency gains.
* Demonstrated ability to develop, track, and present manufacturing KPIs.
* Working knowledge of ERP systems and shop floor data (Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central experience a plus).
* Willingness and preference to spend the workday on the production floor rather than in an office.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills; ability to give direct feedback and hold people accountable without losing them.
* Experience leading a direct labor workforce of 20\+ employees.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Operations Management, or equivalent experience earned on the floor.
* Background as a machinist, CNC programmer, or manufacturing engineer with progression into operations leadership.
* Experience in fluid power, hydraulics, or pneumatics.
* Hands\-on experience with CAD/CAM software such as Mastercam, SolidWorks, or equivalent.
* Experience with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or Kaizen methodologies.
* Familiarity with ISO or equivalent quality standards.
* Experience with welding, assembly, test, and paint operations.
* Experience with preventive maintenance programs and machine reliability.
* Experience building a machinist training, cross\-training, or apprenticeship program.

**Physical and Mental Demands:**

This position is based on the manufacturing floor and is expected to be there 90% or more of the workday. title: Procurement Director
description:
**Procurement Director**

STS Group is seeking an experienced, organized, and highly accountable Procurement Director to lead purchasing, vendor relationships, and procurement processes across the organization.

This is a hands\-on leadership role for someone who understands how purchasing decisions affect job schedules, costs, and field productivity. We want someone who negotiates effectively, follows through on commitments, and makes sure our teams have the materials and equipment they need when they need them.

The Procurement Director will partner with operations, project teams, warehouse personnel, and accounting to plan purchases, manage supplier performance, and improve visibility from purchase request through delivery. This individual will own procurement strategy while staying involved in daily execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Procurement Leadership and Planning**

* Develop and execute a purchasing strategy that supports operational needs, budgets, and company growth.
* Translate project schedules and field requirements into purchasing priorities, including advance planning for long lead items.
* Establish clear purchasing procedures, approval workflows, and accountability within company spending authority.
* Lead and develop procurement personnel, set expectations, and follow through on deadlines.

**Vendor Selection and Negotiation**

* Evaluate suppliers based on pricing, quality, availability, service, and delivery reliability.
* Negotiate pricing, payment terms, freight, warranties, and returns within approved authority.
* Build dependable vendor relationships and maintain alternate sources for critical materials.
* Track supplier performance, address recurring problems, and escalate unresolved issues before they affect operations.

**Purchasing and Order Management**

* Oversee purchase requests and purchase orders for accurate specifications, quantities, pricing, job coding, and approvals.
* Confirm order acknowledgments and delivery dates; actively follow up on open orders and backorders.
* Coordinate approved substitutions with the appropriate project or technical personnel.
* Resolve shortages, damaged shipments, incorrect orders, returns, and outstanding vendor credits.

**Key Responsibilities Continued**

**Material Availability and Inventory Coordination**

* Partner with warehouse and field teams to align replenishment with actual usage and upcoming work.
* Coordinate receiving, staging, and delivery so materials reach the right job or location on time.
* Review stock levels, slow\-moving items, and excess purchases to reduce shortages and avoid unnecessary inventory.
* Improve visibility into what has been ordered, received, committed to a job, or remains outstanding.

**Cost Control and Accounting Coordination**

* Analyze purchasing activity, price changes, freight, and total acquisition costs to identify savings without sacrificing quality or reliability.
* Partner with accounting to resolve differences among purchase orders, receipts, and vendor invoices.
* Maintain accurate purchasing records, supplier agreements, and documentation supporting negotiated terms.
* Provide leadership with clear reporting on purchasing costs, supplier performance, open orders, and procurement risks.

**Process Improvement and Accountability**

* Identify recurring purchasing problems and implement practical, documented solutions.
* Improve use of purchasing and operational systems to reduce duplicate orders, manual work, and missing information.
* Track measures such as on\-time delivery, purchase price variance, emergency purchases, and vendor credits.
* Communicate shortages, delays, and cost concerns early, with recommended actions and clear ownership.

**Qualifications**

Required

* 7 or more years of progressive procurement, purchasing, or supply chain experience, including leadership responsibility.
* Demonstrated success negotiating with suppliers and managing purchasing from request through delivery.
* Experience supporting time\-sensitive operational or project needs and resolving material availability issues.
* Strong understanding of purchase orders, inventory coordination, vendor terms, and purchasing controls.
* Strong Excel skills and experience using purchasing, inventory, or business management systems.
* Sound judgment, clear communication, and the ability to manage competing priorities and hold others accountable.

**Preferred**

* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, business, or a related field.
* Experience with ServiceTitan or a comparable inventory tracking platform.
* Experience improving procurement processes and developing purchasing teams.

**The Person We Are Looking For**

You take ownership of what happens after an order is placed. If a delivery date slips, you find out why, identify options, and communicate the impact before a technician or project team is left waiting.

You look beyond the quoted price. You consider availability, freight, quality, warranty support, and the cost of delays. You know when to challenge a vendor, when to involve operations, and when a decision needs leadership approval.

* Follow through until purchasing issues are resolved.
* Ask questions when quantities, pricing, or specifications do not make sense.
* Communicate problems early and bring practical options.
* Build consistent processes and keep purchasing information organized.
* Balance cost control with the needs of the people doing the work.
* Hold yourself, your team, and suppliers accountable for commitments.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Materials and equipment are available when needed, with fewer preventable delays.
* Open orders and backorders are actively managed, with reliable status information.
* Purchases follow established approval processes and agreed vendor terms.
* Costs are visible, savings are supported, and emergency purchases are reduced.
* Supplier problems are addressed promptly, and critical items have sourcing alternatives.
* Returns and credits are tracked through completion.
* Procurement, operations, warehouse, and accounting teams work from accurate information.
* Purchasing processes become more consistent and support STS Group as it grows.

**Why STS Group**

STS Group is a growing organization where strong procurement directly supports field execution, project schedules, and financial performance. This position offers the opportunity to take ownership of the procurement function and work closely with company leadership to improve how we purchase and manage materials.

We value people who take ownership, solve problems, communicate proactively, and continuously look for ways to make the organization better.

### **Position Overview**



Align is seeking an experienced Warehouse and Facilities Operations Manager to lead and manage the inventory operations and facilities\-related functions supporting our data center infrastructure business. The ideal candidate would have experience with high\-performance compute cabling, strategic sourcing, project execution, and operational support for warehouse facilities readiness. This role is ideal for a hands\-on leader with experience in warehouse operations, inventory management, construction, telecom, or data center environments who thrives in a fast\-paced, client\-focused setting.  

  

The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong leadership in project management and team oversight, ensuring seamless coordination across technical teams, warehouse operations, and facilities\-related support activities. This individual will bring proven experience in inventory management, warehouse and facilities management, optimizing vendor relationships and material acquisition to support project timelines and budget goals. They will also collaborate with sales operations, procurement and client engagement by communicating effectively with internal stakeholders and end users to align deliverables with expectations and drive customer satisfaction.


* This is a full\-time salaried position offering competitive compensation commensurate with experience, comprehensive benefits, paid time off, paid training, and performance\-based bonuses.

**Job Title: Manager, Manufacturing Engineering (Manager, MPES Demand Planning \& SIOP – Maritime Sector)** **Job Code: 44126** **Job Location:** **Camden, NJ (On\-Site)****Schedule: 9/80 Regular** (Employees work 9 out of every 14 days – totaling 80 hours worked – and have every other Friday off) **Job Description:**The Manager, MPES Demand Planning \& SIOP – Maritime Sector leads demand planning, SIOP, and master scheduling activities for MPES and the broader Maritime business. This role oversees the MPES Demand Planning/SIOP/Master Scheduling team while consolidating and analyzing demand from multiple internal and external sources. The manager develops a comprehensive 18–24 month rolling demand plan, ensures alignment between demand, supply, and capacity, and drives the monthly demand review process. The position provides data\-driven insights to support strategic decisions and operational execution across Maritime sites. **Essential Functions:**  

* Lead, develop, and manage the MPES Demand Planning/SIOP/Master Scheduling team.
* Define and document roles, responsibilities, and standard processes for demand planning, SIOP, and master scheduling.
* Serve as the primary SIOP and demand planning lead, ensuring demand, supply, and capacity alignment across Maritime sites.
* Consolidate and validate demand inputs from cross\-functional partners and analyze sales orders, forecasts, market trends, and historical data.
* Maintain an accurate 18–24 month rolling demand plan and monitor changes, risks, and opportunities.
* Lead demand reviews within the SIOP cycle and update plans based on business priorities and operational capabilities.
* Partner with Supply Planning, Operations, and Master Scheduling to translate demand plans into executable production and capacity plans.
* Oversee master scheduling compliance with approved demand and SIOP outputs.
* Develop reports and metrics to track forecast accuracy, inventory health, schedule adherence, and overall SIOP performance.
* Communicate demand insights and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Apply analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and draw actionable insights.
* Drive continuous improvement in forecasting accuracy, data quality, process efficiency, and tool adoption.
* Ensure accuracy and quality in all data analysis, reporting, and documentation through strong attention to detail.
* Ability to lead and influence across functions and levels without direct authority.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities.
* Ability to obtain a US Government Security Clearance.
* Travel occasionally to Maritime sites as needed.

 **Qualifications:**  

* Bachelor’s Degree and minimum 9 years of prior relevant experience in planning, operations, manufacturing, or supply chain; OR Graduate Degree and a minimum of 7 years of prior related experience; OR in lieu of a degree, minimum of 12 years of prior related experience.
* At least 5 years of experience in demand planning and/or SIOP, preferably within the aerospace and defense industry and supporting multiple sites.
* At least 2 years of experience leading or managing planning, SIOP, or master scheduling activities in a complex environment.
* 5 plus years of experience working with SI processes and principles.
* 5\+ years of experience working with ERP systems, specifically Deltek Costpoint, in demand and inventory management.
* Minimum 7 years of experience with supply chain principles, including inventory optimization, capacity planning, and risk management.
* Minimum 4 years of experience working with demand planning software and advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Power BI.

 **Preferred Additional Skills:**  

* Degree in Operations Management, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or related technical discipline.
* Knowledge of aerospace and defense industry regulations, market dynamics, and customer requirements.
* Experience collaborating with Program Management and Engineering to support IPT requirements.
* Proficiency in MRP systems and related planning tools.
* Demonstrated expertise in master scheduling, capacity planning, production planning, and inventory management.
* Experience designing and documenting end\-to\-end demand planning and SIOP processes.
* Certification in supply chain management (e.g., APICS CPIM, CSCP).
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate and drive consensus across functions and levels.
* Commitment to continuous learning and professional development in demand planning, SIOP, and supply chain management.
